name: Return to lifting — full body ×2 + run
notes: Weeks 1–2: stop every set with 2 reps in reserve. From week 3 the app raises the weight when every set hits the top of its rep range.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.cue: Sit between your heels, chest up, drive the floor away.

exercises.name: Bench press
exercises.cue: Feet planted, shoulder blades pinched, bar to lower chest.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.cue: Pull elbows to hips, squeeze the shoulder blades, no leaning back.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Hips back, bar slides down the thighs, feel the hamstrings, soft knees.

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
exercises.cue: Curl the pelvis up, no swinging.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.cue: Dumbbell at the chest, sit between the heels.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.cue: Body in one line, elbows at 45°.

exercises.name: Single-arm row (each side)
exercises.cue: Hand on a chair, elbow to hip, no twisting.

exercises.name: Step-up onto a chair (each leg)
exercises.cue: Hold the dumbbell at the chest, drive through the top foot, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Single-arm overhead press (each side)
exercises.cue: Ribs down, don't lean back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Both dumbbells, hips back, hamstrings loaded.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Squeeze glutes, breathe.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.cue: Bar over mid-foot, brace, push the floor away, lock out tall.

exercises.name: Overhead press
exercises.cue: Squeeze glutes, bar straight up, head through at the top.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cue: Elbows down to the ribs, chest up.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Full range, knees track over toes, don't lock out hard.

exercises.name: Cable crunch
exercises.cue: Round the spine, elbows to knees.

days.title: Easy run · 5–7 km
days.cue: Conversational pace. Distance is yours; log km, minutes and how it felt.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.cue: Body in one line, elbows at 45°.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.cue: Slow down, pause at the bottom.

exercises.name: Step-up (each leg)
exercises.cue: Use a stair or sturdy chair, control the way down.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
exercises.cue: Hips high, head towards the floor between the hands.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Squeeze at the top for a second.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.cue: Squeeze glutes, breathe.

exercises.name: Superman hold
exercises.cue: Lift chest and thighs, hold one second.
